title_zh: 确定学校发明展示的原型和测试方法

scenario.label_zh: 规划学校发明项目的原型
scenario.goal_zh: 从日常问题出发选定原型材料并说明可观察的测试方法

context_zh: 学生与老师讨论学校展示项目，选用简单材料测试桌面电线固定夹。
author: author-phase04-a

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: The brief says we should invent something that solves an everyday problem. Does it have to be complicated?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen
sentences.text: No. What small problem would you like to solve?

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: My charging cable keeps falling behind my desk. My invention could be a clip that holds it at the edge.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen
sentences.text: That sounds manageable. What material would you use for the first model?

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Thick cardboard, before I try anything stronger. Can I make it in the lab?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen
sentences.text: Yes, during project time. How will you test whether it works?

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: My method will be to try it on three desk edges and record whether the cable stays in place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen
sentences.text: Good. Bring a sketch tomorrow, and we will check the shape before you build it.
